description: She has worked her tail off for us in the House over the last four years. As a REALTOR, I've watched clients leave Vermont as they've become taxed out of their home, or because the cost of childcare in the state they were born and raised in had simply become too high. I've watched Ashley fight to keep Vermont affordable and within reach for families who want to stay here.
